operations.reason: Raw MD0033 is 512px tall, but its first 16px are black source padding rather than room geometry. The RDX room also omits one complete 64px barrel/ladder deck that exists in Classic. Build a 560px effective RDX room by discarding the black padding, keeping the decoded 16px stone ceiling row once, restoring the missing barrel deck from the matching decoded RDX section, and keeping the raw lower room/bottom boundary once. Do not extend the top or bottom to Classic height; the Fluid-v2 camera clamps to the effective RDX room and therefore shows more interior below at the top. Terrain collision descriptors follow the same slice map, while raw RDX ML20 exits are suppressed because xrick connector identity and the reviewed Layer-D exit remain authoritative after the structural splice.

Bind the single natural MD0033 right-side ML20 exit to xrick row 0x48 (SM1A -> SM1B). The topology splice maps its raw source cell at y=432 to effective y=480 after cropping the 16px source padding and restoring the missing 64px deck. Connector identity remains the xrick rowout/rowin pair.
